Subject: The same original adult woman from the supplied project proposal: fair focused face, long dark-brown wavy hair parted slightly off centre, black leather motorcycle jacket and muted burgundy scoop-neck top. Preserve her serious confident expression and clear both eyes of hair. No stake, hands, holster or new jewellery.
Style/medium: refined collectible-character rendering matching the reference's sculpted forms and hand-painted material treatment. Clear broad value groups, simple readable face landmarks, restrained surface detail. Do not imitate any existing commercial card illustration.
Composition: one square image, only head and shoulders. Face centered, both eyes looking toward the viewer. Include the entire hairstyle and headwear with generous quiet margin above and beside it. Whole head must fit within the full centered circular crop inscribed in the square; shoulders may be cut by the circle. No tight smaller crop. Clear face and distinctive head silhouette at40px, upper chest at lower edge.
Backdrop: quiet uniform dark navy #061623, no scenery.
Lighting: soft studio illumination makes both eyes and facial landmarks clear; no black eye sockets, lens glare, flare or rim glow.
Constraints: no words, text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, circle outline, border, card frame, UI, full body or pedestal. No duplicate face, extra characters, actor features directive, new props or hands. Preserve the proposed reference palette and identity without claiming canon.
